props.title: Customization Options for Themed Playgrounds
props.summaryText: From a colour change to a one-off design: the levels of customisation available for themed playgrounds, what each involves, and how to choose a theme that suits your site.
props.author: rohan-mehta
props.imageAlt: Illustration of a conceptual musical-themed playground design

takeaways.text: Customisation has levels: colours, then themes on standard structures, then adapted layouts, then fully custom designs.
Themes on standard structures (castle, jungle, robot, circus, nature) cost little extra and are quick to supply.
Fully custom designs need design time and sometimes new moulds, so they cost more and take longer.
Choose a theme that suits the site and the users, and that will still feel right in ten years.

faq.a: Yes. Most manufacturers offer colour changes and themed designs on standard structures, and some offer adapted layouts and fully custom designs. The more custom the design, the longer the lead time and the higher the cost.

Castles, jungles and nature, robots and space, circus, ships and sea life, and themes inspired by Indian culture and games. Resorts and builders sometimes ask for themes linked to their brand or location.

faq.q: How long does a custom playground take?
faq.a: Colour changes and standard themed structures take little extra time. Adapted layouts take longer for drawings and approvals. Fully custom designs can take considerably longer because of design development and possibly new moulds.
